_readme: For Reddit/forum threads, X posts and HN discussion itself, where the point is reading the room, not citing a scholarly record. Peer-review scoring is switched off (these URLs are never preprint hosts, but the switch also stops a stray DOI/arXiv link on a discussion page from getting academic treatment). Engagement caps go up further than non_academic, and a short 'opinion' half-life is added and made the default field since discussions age fast.
